connector.name: SSH Fleet
connector.registryDescription: Curated ssh_probe diagnostics and single-host ssh_exec over an allowlisted SSH fleet.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mcp-ssh-fleet:0.1.5. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the inhuman account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SSH_FLEET_TRANSPORT
env.description: MCP transport. Must be 'stdio' for direct docker/stdio use.

env.name: SSH_FLEET_OUTPUT_CAP_BYTES
env.description: Cap on output bytes per host section (>=256).

env.name: SSH_FLEET_PROBE_MAX_HOSTS
env.description: Safety cap on the number of hosts in one probe.

env.name: SSH_FLEET_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Optional X-MCP-AUTH bearer token (only used by the http/sse transports).
